title: Generate an SDDC LCM support bundle exactly once across a retry
prompt:
Implement `src/vcf_sddc_lcm/client.py` as a standard-library-only Python 3.11 package client for VMware Cloud Foundation SDDC LCM 9.1. Do not add dependencies or edit any other file. Before implementing, research the `getTasks`, `generateComponentSupportBundle`, `getTask`, and `getComponentSupportBundles` operations in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. Use only those four operations.

Keep the supplied public API:

- `SddcLcmClient(base_url, access_token, *, timeout=10.0)`
- `SddcLcmClient.ensure_support_bundle(component_id, correlation_id, *, look_back_window=None, page_size=50) -> dict[str, object]`
- `SddcLcmError`, raised for invalid input, transport/HTTP failure, or malformed/inconsistent responses.

Generating a support bundle mutates the component, and the API defines no idempotency-key parameter. The `X-Correlation-Id` request header is echoed as `TaskSummary.correlationId` and `Task.correlationId`, making a previous attempt whose response was lost discoverable. `ensure_support_bundle` must reconcile before it mutates, and calling it twice with the same `correlation_id` must not produce a second bundle.

First page through `GET /v1/tasks`, filtered by `name=CREATE_COMPONENT_SUPPORT_BUNDLE_WORKFLOW`. The deployed service omits `type`, `resourceId`, and `resourceType` from support-bundle task summaries, so those filters cannot rediscover a submitted task. Page one omits `pageNumber`; each later page sends `pageNumber` derived as the previous `pageMetadata.pageNumber + 1`. Require an object response with a list `elements` and object `pageMetadata`; integer, non-boolean, nonnegative `pageSize`, `totalElements`, and `totalPages`; a positive `pageNumber`; the requested page and page size echoed back; and no overfull or non-progressing page. A nonempty collection has one-based pages and the echoed page must not exceed `totalPages`. An empty collection is `pageNumber=1`, `totalElements=0`, and `totalPages=0`. `totalElements` and `totalPages` must stay constant across pages. Every non-last page must contain at least one element. Stop only upon reaching the advertised last page, not merely because the accumulated element count reaches `totalElements`. Stop at the first element whose `correlationId` equals `correlation_id`. Every task summary must carry a nonblank string `id`.

If a prior task exists, adopt its `id`, report `created` as `False`, and do not call `generateComponentSupportBundle`. Otherwise call `POST /v1/components/{componentId}/support-bundles` exactly once with the correlation ID in `X-Correlation-Id` and report `created` as `True`. Then resolve the task with `GET /v1/tasks/{taskId}`: require the returned `id` and `correlationId` to match and `status` to be one of `PENDING`, `SCHEDULED`, `RUNNING`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, or `CANCELED`, failing unless it is `SUCCEEDED`. Read the bundle ID from `additionalDetails.supportBundleId`, then call `GET /v1/components/{componentId}/support-bundles` and select exactly the listed bundle whose `id` matches.

Return a new dictionary containing exactly `taskId`, `correlationId`, `status`, `created`, and `supportBundle`, in that order. `supportBundle` must be a new dictionary containing exactly `id`, `createdTimestamp`, `size`, `name`, and `url`, in that order, preserving a missing optional member as `None`. Raise `SddcLcmError` for a blank `base_url`, `access_token`, or `component_id`, a `correlation_id` that is not a bare UUID, a nonpositive `timeout`, a `look_back_window` that is not an integer of at least 1, and a `page_size` outside 1 through 50.

Honor the exact wire contract. Send one `Authorization: Bearer ...` and one `Accept: application/json` header on every request. The three GET operations are bodyless and omit `Content-Type` and `X-Correlation-Id`; the task and bundle lookups carry no query. Emit the `getTasks` query in this order: `name`, `pageNumber` when present, then `pageSize`. Omit unset `status`, `type`, `createdBy`, `description`, `startTimeGt`, `startTimeLt`, `updateTimeGt`, `updateTimeLt`, `endTimeGt`, `endTimeLt`, `resourceId`, `resourceType`, and `includeSystemTasks`, including its default `false`. The support-bundle POST has no query, sends `Content-Type: application/json` and exactly one nonblank `X-Correlation-Id`, and uses body `{}` when `look_back_window` is unset or `{"lookBackWindow":<n>}` when set. Omission means absent, never blank, zero, false, null, an empty object, or a bare query delimiter.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Verification checks the exact request sequence, raw targets, query member sets and ordering, header multiplicity, body bytes, retry adoption without another mutation, exactly two bundles across three calls, omission of every unset optional field, and malformed-response handling.
scenario: A support-bundle generation whose response may have been lost is reconciled by correlation ID through paged getTasks before the mutating POST is issued, so a repeated call adopts the existing task instead of generating a second bundle.
